heading: Agent tokens
intro: Give an AI agent its own credential to review your documents over MCP. Each token is named, scoped to this workspace, and works only on the agent endpoint — never on the rest of the API, so an agent can never approve, change a document's state, or create another token.
namePlaceholder: What is this agent? e.g. Claude Code
createdOnce: Copy this token now — it is shown once and cannot be recovered.
copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the token and copy it manually.
loadFailed: Could not load your agent tokens. Reload the page — do not assume the list is empty.
scopeHint: Revoking is immediate: the agent's next call fails. Tokens reach only this workspace's documents.
